message: I’ve always been the one who ends up scrambling when things go sideways, but I’m determined to change that. I stumbled upon a great resource from the Red Cross about preparing for fire emergencies, and it really opened my eyes. 🔥 It’s all about knowing what to do before a situation arises, and honestly, feeling a bit more in control is such a relief. Have you ever thought about how ready you feel in an emergency?
